label: Book Cover
description: A cover that has to sell the book as a thumbnail: one arresting image, a genre a reader recognises in half a second, and room reserved for the type.
prefix: A book cover design, one arresting image built to sell the story at thumbnail size
suffix: composed as a cover: a clear focal image with deliberate empty space reserved for the title and the author's name, strong value contrast, portrait format
negative: spine, back cover, mockup on a table, hands holding the book, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers
